The '''Mission to Alzoc III''' was a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]] given to [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had set up a trap for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces with his [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was considered to be in the territory controlled by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]] temporarily became a point of interest for both sides of the conflict. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] had stolen the [[Gravitic Core]] of a new [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Gravitic polarization beam|superweapon]] in orbit above the planet, leaving the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] that was carrying it to be hit by an explosion. The [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] crashed on Alzoc, where the gravitic technology had created a gravity anomaly, causing the wreckage to float in the air near the crash site alongside ice debris. Shortly thereafter, Jabba had informed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] of the CIS activity near the planet, hoping to punish the Separatist for passing through his territory without payment. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] had dispatched [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] to investigate the report.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

[[File:AlzocMission.jpg|thumb|left|[[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]], [[Bly/Legends|Bly]], [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and clone troopers on Alzoc III.]]
Accompanied by a detachment of [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] led by [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]], two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had arrived at Alzoc, dispatching several [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]] to the planet's surface. However, by that time the crash site was already visited by a Confederate [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. In order to keep the new gravitic weapon a secret, Dooku ordered his agent to destroy any evidence of the incident and allow no witness to be left alive. When the Republic forces arrived at the crash cite, both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were stunned by the view of a huge masses of ice and numerous starship parts floating freely in the air and decided to investigate. They were engaged by many [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stationed on the frigate, who survived the crash relatively intact and now viewed the Republic forces as hostile. On their way to what remained of the frigate's central [[Computer/Legends|computer]], the Jedi were ambushed by the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] assassin. After a brief duel, two Jedi Masters have overpowered the Dark Acolyte, trapping her under the bulk of ice. After finding the ship's computer, the Republic forces were able to uncover the record of the ship's last moments, learning about the existence of the gravitic weapon.<ref name="TCW:RH" />
